stats.description: How much punishment the creature can still take. It mends slowly.

descriptors.description: Critical. Barely standing; every hit could drop it.
Badly hurt. Bleeding from many wounds; it moves and fights slower.
Hurt. Scorched and scratched, but still at full stride.
Unhurt. Its hide is barely marked.

stats.description: The creature's energy for attacks, sprints and climbs. A pause between assaults restores it.

descriptors.description: Spent. It can barely lift a limb and must rest.
Tired. Its movements are slow and heavy.
Winded. Breathing hard, but able to keep going.
Fresh. Ready for anything.

stats.name: Stamina

stats.description: The creature's fury. It rises as it smashes and fights, cools while it holds back, and makes every blow bigger.

descriptors.description: Calm. Its blows land like any big animal's.
Riled. Each blow hits noticeably harder.
Furious. Sweeping strikes level a building at a time.
Unstoppable. Each blow flattens a block.

stats.name: Rampage

stats.description: How deep the creature's frenzy runs. It shows only while Berserk State is on, and it climbs each turn.

descriptors.description: Seething. The frenzy has just taken hold.
Frenzied. It charges whatever is nearest and ignores its wounds.
Wild. It tears into everything in reach and stops only when nothing is left standing near it.
Lost. Nothing is left but the fury.

stats.name: Berserk

traitGroups.playerDescription: How the news and the military describe you. Pick one.

traitGroups.name: Mutations
traitGroups.playerDescription: Each mutation trades something for something. Take any number.

traitGroups.playerDescription: What kind of colossus you are. Pick one.

traits.aiDescription: The kaiju is male.
traits.name: Masculine
traits.playerDescription: The news and the military call you "he."

traits.aiDescription: The kaiju is female.
traits.name: Feminine
traits.playerDescription: The news and the military call you "she."

traits.aiDescription: The kaiju is a two-legged reptile with a long tail, sharp fangs and heavy claws. It stomps, bites, and sweeps buildings aside with its tail.
traits.name: Reptile
traits.playerDescription: A hulking reptile on two legs, with a long tail, sharp fangs and heavy claws.

traits.aiDescription: The kaiju is a two-legged insect with mandibles, armored plates and spiked limbs. It slashes, climbs towers, and grips with its spiked limbs.
traits.name: Insect
traits.playerDescription: A hulking insect on two legs, with mandibles, armored plates and spiked limbs.

traits.aiDescription: The kaiju is a spider with eight furred legs and venomous mandibles. It scuttles over rooftops, spits venom, and spins cables of web between towers.
traits.name: Arachnid
traits.playerDescription: A hulking spider with eight furred legs and venomous mandibles.

traits.aiDescription: The kaiju is a human as tall as the towers. Its hands grab, lift and throw whatever is in reach.
traits.name: Giant
traits.playerDescription: A human as tall as the towers, with hands that grab, lift and throw.

traits.aiDescription: The kaiju's hide shrugs off gunfire and shells, but its bulk makes it slow to turn and react.
traits.name: Armored Hide
traits.playerDescription: Your hide shrugs off gunfire. All that bulk slows you down.

traits.aiDescription: The kaiju's fury starts high and flares fast, and every outburst winds it.
traits.name: Short Fuse
traits.playerDescription: Your fury starts high and runs hot. Each burst leaves you more winded.

traits.aiDescription: The kaiju keeps attacking long after it should tire, and its body takes more damage for it.
traits.name: Unrelenting
traits.playerDescription: You attack tirelessly. Your body pays for it.

traits.aiDescription: The kaiju has a breath weapon of fire, venom or energy, matching its type. A blast levels a block or swats aircraft from the sky, and each one exhausts it.
traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.playerDescription: A ranged breath of fire, venom or energy, to match your type. Each blast takes a lot out of you.

traits.aiDescription: The kaiju regenerates: its wounds knit closed over minutes, and the healing drains its energy.
traits.name: Regenerator
traits.playerDescription: Your wounds knit closed as you watch. The healing burns energy you could spend smashing.

traits.aiDescription: The kaiju has vast wings. It glides or flies short hops between districts, over cordons and armor. Its frame is lighter and easier to hurt.
traits.name: Wings
traits.playerDescription: Vast wings carry you between districts and over the military's heads. Your frame is lighter and easier to hurt.

traits.aiDescription: The kaiju is berserk: it charges the nearest target, attacks wildly and ignores pain and caution.

descriptors.description: Critical condition. Severely hurt, barely upright, in real trouble.
Injured. Multiple knocks and strains, movement impaired.
Hurt. Minor scrapes and bruises, some pain, but generally functional.
Healthy. No significant injuries, operating at full capacity.

stats.name: Health

stats.description: The player's energy for running, climbing and holding themselves together. Rest restores it.

descriptors.description: Exhausted. Barely able to move, risk of collapse, unable to perform strenuous actions.
Tired. Movements are sluggish, difficulty in sustained physical activities.
Winded. Slightly out of breath, can perform most actions but not at peak efficiency.
Energetic. Full of energy, capable of performing any physical action without hindrance.

stats.name: Stamina

stats.description: How far the slime has spread through the player. Its script adds the spread for each story hour. Slime contact raises it; remedies, rest in dry warmth and salt-scrubbing lower it.

descriptors.description: Early signs. A faint green tint under the fingernails; skin cool to the touch. Nothing anyone would notice in this fog.

Translucent. Skin faintly see-through at the wrists and temples; joints move too smoothly. The player can compress their hands and arms through gaps bones should forbid, and slimes pause before striking — half-reading them as kin.
Softening. The player’s outline blurs in the rain; grip fails on anything heavy; recent memories arrive syrupy and out of order. Slimes ignore them entirely now. People very much do not.
Assimilated. The player settles into the goo — calm, painless, and no longer the person who started tonight. The story ends here, quietly.

stats.name: Assimilation

stats.description: The player's fear. It rises in encounters and darkness and settles in safety and light.

descriptors.description: Level. Breathing even, thoughts in order.
Rattled. Jumping at drips and shadows; hands not quite steady.
Fraying. Tunnel vision, snap decisions, the urge to just run somewhere, anywhere.
Panicking. The player acts before thinking — loud, fast, and visible to everything.

traitGroups.playerDescription: Who you were yesterday, when Ashburn was just damp. Pick one.

traitGroups.name: Disposition
traitGroups.playerDescription: How you carry a very bad night. Pick one.

traitGroups.aiDescription: What the player is carrying tonight:
traitGroups.name: Pockets
traitGroups.playerDescription: What you grabbed on the way out the door. Take any.

traits.aiDescription: The player is a night-shift nurse. They know which remedies actually slow the film, how to dress a wound, and how to talk to exhausted officials, and their steady habits slow the spread.
traits.name: Night-Shift Nurse
traits.playerDescription: You know which pharmacy shelves matter, and your habits slow the spread.

traits.aiDescription: The player worked the Ashburn docks for years: they know the Harborfront’s gates, catwalks, and shortcuts, including the seawall route to the chemical works, and hard work built a durable body.
traits.name: Dock Worker
traits.playerDescription: Twenty years on the Harborfront. You know every gate, gap, and gantry.

traits.aiDescription: The player is an Ashburn High student: young, quick to recover, and intimately familiar with the school-turned-shelter, the alleys between districts, and every fence with a loose board.
traits.name: Ashburn High Student
traits.playerDescription: You know the school, the shortcuts, and which fences have loose boards.

traits.aiDescription: The player stays deliberate under pressure — fear drains away quickly and rarely drives their choices.
traits.name: Steady Hands
traits.playerDescription: Slow breath, clean decisions.

traits.aiDescription: The player’s instinct is to move: deep stamina reserves and fast recovery, but their nerves run hot and settle slowly.
traits.name: Runner's Instinct
traits.playerDescription: First to move, last to tire — and always a little wired.

traits.aiDescription: The player is more fascinated than afraid: they can hold themselves together far past the point others break, observing details everyone else misses — and it draws them closer to danger than is wise.
traits.name: Morbid Curiosity
traits.playerDescription: You take notes while other people scream. It gets you closer than is wise.

traits.aiDescription: The player carries handfuls of diner salt packets: a thrown handful makes any slime recoil and buys seconds, and a salted doorway holds all night. The supply is finite — track its use.
traits.name: Salt Packets
traits.playerDescription: Two pockets full of diner salt. The slimes have opinions about it.

traits.aiDescription: The player wears a long coat and gloves that hide the visible signs of assimilation — patrols and civilians see a bundled-up resident, not a condition, until the signs pass what fabric can cover.
traits.name: Long Coat & Gloves
traits.playerDescription: Covers the wrists, the temples, the tint. People see a coat, not a condition.

traits.aiDescription: The player carries a pocket radio tuned to the quarantine band: they overhear patrol movements, checkpoint rotations, and the municipal broadcast before anyone else reacts to it.
traits.name: Pocket Radio
traits.playerDescription: Tuned to the quarantine band. Knowing beats guessing.

traits.aiDescription: ACTIVE: the player is fighting the change with everything they have: flexing warmth back into their hands, saying their own name, holding their shape. The spread slows while this holds, and the effort drains their stamina fast.
traits.name: Fight It
traits.playerDescription: Hold yourself together. The spread slows while you do, and it drains your Stamina fast.

stats.description: The curse of unending hunger. It climbs by itself between turns. When the player eats, lower it: a little for a bite, a lot for a meal. On a turn without eating, leave it unchanged.

descriptors.description: Quiet. The hunger naps; thoughts are entirely the player's own.

Roaring. The player's hands drift toward food on their own; resisting takes real, visible effort.
Ravenous. The curse takes the wheel — the player will eat the nearest edible thing unless something stops them.

stats.description: How much the player has eaten. Raise it with every bite: a little for a nibble, a lot for a feast. It falls slowly as they digest.

descriptors.description: Empty. Hollow and rumbling — the curse loves this.
Comfortable. Fed and fully mobile.
Full. Stretched and slower; jumping is a bad idea.
Overstuffed. Waddling at best — running is a fantasy, and the player mostly wants to lie down in the frosting.

stats.name: Fullness

stats.description: How much sugar, syrup and cream coats the player. Raise it for messy eating, gummy pools and sugar dust. Lower it when they wash, most of all in the cream surf.

descriptors.description: Clean-ish. A dusting of powdered sugar; unremarkable to the wildlife.
Dusted. Tacky fingers, sparkling hair; a passing swarmer's antennae twitch toward the player.
Sticky. Trailing caramel threads; sprinkle swarmers change course toward the player.
A walking dessert. Syrup-coated head to toe — every creature in sight considers the player food.

stats.name: Stickiness

traitGroups.name: Appetite

traitGroups.name: Pantry Tricks

traits.aiDescription: The player can eat enormous amounts in one sitting before they feel it, and the curse burns hotter in them.

traits.playerDescription: Go big. You have room for a feast, and the curse climbs faster for it.

traits.playerDescription: Quick over the crumb fields, quicker up a wafer tree.

traits.playerDescription: Takes a pouncer ram like a compliment.

traits.playerDescription: Cyclones throw you further — but you land softer.

traits.aiDescription: The player can eat far past the point most people would burst, staying mobile where others would be waddling.
traits.name: Iron Stomach
traits.playerDescription: Room for seconds. And thirds.

traits.aiDescription: Food truly satisfies the player. Every meal quiets the curse longer than it should.
traits.name: Hearty Appetite
traits.playerDescription: Meals actually satisfy you. The curse climbs slower, and you have more room.

traits.aiDescription: Sugar hits the player like rocket fuel: bursts of speed and energy after eating, and a hunger that comes back sooner.

traits.aiDescription: The player can sustain hard physical effort for a long time, at the cost of a fast metabolism that burns through food.
traits.name: Endurance Athlete
traits.playerDescription: Built for the long haul, but the engine wants fuel.

traits.aiDescription: The player is adapted to harsh conditions. They need less food than most and shake off poisons faster.
traits.name: Survivalist
traits.playerDescription: Needs less, endures more.

traits.aiDescription: The player stays calm under pressure. Fear passes through them and drains away quickly.
traits.name: Zen Master
traits.playerDescription: The dark is just the dark.

traits.aiDescription: The player thrives on danger. They have deeper energy reserves and recover faster, but their nerves never fully settle.
traits.name: Adrenaline Junkie
traits.playerDescription: Fear is fuel. It just never quite switches off.

traits.aiDescription: Eating soothes the player. Their fear fades fast, but their appetite runs ahead of their supplies.
traits.name: Stress Eater
traits.playerDescription: Calm comes by the mouthful.

traits.aiDescription: The player tolerates toxins far better than most and purges them faster.
traits.name: Iron Stomach
traits.playerDescription: A gut that argues with poison, and usually wins.

traits.aiDescription: The player can eat large amounts when food is there and draws more from every meal.
traits.name: Hearty Appetite
traits.playerDescription: You can eat big when the chance comes, and it carries you farther.

traits.aiDescription: The player notices what others miss: a wrong color on a cap, a too-still shadow, a hunter's sign before the hunter. They walk into danger far less often.
traits.name: Keen Eye
traits.playerDescription: You see the wrong color and the too-still shadow before they see you.

traits.aiDescription: The player moves slowly and carefully, testing each step, breathing shallow and touching nothing. They are very hard to hear or track, but they cover ground slowly, and the strain tires them.
traits.name: Move Quietly
traits.playerDescription: Slow, tested steps and shallow breathing. Hard to track, and tiring.

traits.aiDescription: The wood turns the player in circles. Every path except east bends back toward the Drowned Hollow, and the player keeps finding their own tracks. East, the way the lantern moths drift at dusk, is the one direction that keeps going.
traits.name: The Veil's Hold
traits.playerDescription: Every path but east bends back toward the heart of the wood, and the hunters learn a little more of you each turn.

traits.aiDescription: The player is badly poisoned and hallucinates. Each turn, weave one false sight or sound into the real wood, built from what the scene already holds, with nothing to mark it as false. The real hunters and the real way east are still among them.
traits.name: Veil Sight
traits.playerDescription: The poison shows you things that aren't there. It passes when Toxin falls below 75%.

stats.description: How much harm the player's body can take. Lower it for falls, bites and poison. Raise it when a mushroom's effects mend the player.

descriptors.description: Critical condition. Severely wounded, barely conscious, and at risk of death.
Injured. Suffering from multiple wounds, movement impaired, combat effectiveness reduced.
Hurt. Minor injuries present, some pain, but generally functional.
Healthy. No significant injuries, operating at full capacity.

stats.name: Health

stats.description: The player's energy for running, climbing and wading. Lower it for hard effort. Raise it when the player rests or eats a mushroom that restores it.

descriptors.description: Exhausted. Barely able to move, risk of collapse, unable to perform strenuous actions.
Tired. Movements are sluggish, difficulty in sustained physical activities.
Winded. Slightly out of breath, can perform most actions but not at peak efficiency.
Energetic. Full of energy, capable of performing any physical action without hindrance.

stats.name: Stamina

stats.description: The player's fear and strain. Raise it for darkness, close calls and hallucinations. Lower it for calm, warmth and small victories.

descriptors.description: Calm. Relaxed and clear-headed, able to make rational decisions easily.
Tense. Feeling pressure, slightly irritable, may have difficulty concentrating.
Anxious. High tension, prone to emotional outbursts, decision-making impaired.
Mental breakdown. Overwhelmed by stress, irrational behavior, risk of panic attacks.

stats.name: Stress

stats.description: How fed the player is. Eating moves it by that food's effects.

descriptors.description: Starving. Intense hunger pains, weak and dizzy, risk of fainting, decreased cognitive function.
Hungry. Strong desire for food, stomach growling, difficulty concentrating.
Peckish. Slight hunger, starting to think about food.
Satisfied. Full, no desire for food.

stats.name: Satiety

stats.description: Poison in the player's body. Eating moves it by that food's effects.

descriptors.description: Clear. No poison worth naming; senses steady.
Queasy. A metallic taste; colors slightly too bright.
Poisoned. Stomach cramps, cold sweat, sounds arriving late.
Overwhelmed. The wood melts and rearranges, and nothing the player sees or hears can be trusted.

stats.name: Toxin

traitGroups.playerDescription: What your body brings to a bad week.

traitGroups.name: Temperament
traitGroups.playerDescription: How your mind meets the dark.

traitGroups.name: Instincts
traitGroups.playerDescription: Instincts worth having in a place like this.

traitGroups.aiDescription: The Veilwood's hold on the player:
traitGroups.name: Curse
traitGroups.playerDescription: What the wood does to you. You don't pick these.
